headline: ServiceNow Shares Fall After Hours Despite Beating Q3 Revenue Estimates
summary: ServiceNow reported third-quarter 2026 revenue that topped consensus analyst estimates. However, shares of the cloud software provider declined in extended trading following the report.
why: ServiceNow provides enterprise workflow automation software, serving as an indicator for global enterprise software spending.

impacts.name: ServiceNow, Inc.
impacts.why: Shares slipped in extended trading as quarterly results failed to exceed elevated market expectations.

why_moved: ServiceNow stock slipped after hours as market participants weighed future revenue growth rates despite Q3 outperformance.
